description: Squeal for Codex: validation transitions at tool boundaries, status at Stop. Every hook exits 0 silently in a repository without Squeal; the per-tool hooks check $PWD for squeal.config.json or a store in sh before Node starts. Changing a command here makes users trust that hook again.

hooks.command: s() { [ -n "$1" ] || return 1; d=$1; [ -f "$d/squeal.config.json" ] && return 0; while [ ! -e "$d/.git" ]; do [ -n "$d" ] || return 1; d=${d%/*}; done; [ -f "$d/squeal.config.json" ] && return 0; g=$d/.git; if [ -f "$g" ]; then l=; IFS= read -r l <"$g"; g=${l#gitdir:}; g=${g#"${g%%[! ]*}"}; case $g in /*) ;; *) g=$d/$g ;; esac; c=; [ -f "$g/commondir" ] && IFS= read -r c <"$g/commondir"; case $c in "") ;; /*) g=$c ;; *) g=$g/$c ;; esac; fi; [ -e "$g/squeal" ]; }; s "$PWD" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; exec node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/pre-tool-use.mjs"

s() { [ -n "$1" ] || return 1; d=$1; [ -f "$d/squeal.config.json" ] && return 0; while [ ! -e "$d/.git" ]; do [ -n "$d" ] || return 1; d=${d%/*}; done; [ -f "$d/squeal.config.json" ] && return 0; g=$d/.git; if [ -f "$g" ]; then l=; IFS= read -r l <"$g"; g=${l#gitdir:}; g=${g#"${g%%[! ]*}"}; case $g in /*) ;; *) g=$d/$g ;; esac; c=; [ -f "$g/commondir" ] && IFS= read -r c <"$g/commondir"; case $c in "") ;; /*) g=$c ;; *) g=$g/$c ;; esac; fi; [ -e "$g/squeal" ]; }; s "$PWD" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; exec node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/post-tool-use.mjs"
